svg.title: A real docs jury, round 1 and round 2: CompareGraph's README and docs
svg.desc: CompareGraph's README and docs, judged by seven composite personas, then fixed and judged again. Medians per stratum on a 1 to 5 scale, round 1 then round 2. primary (4 personas): docs find-it 3 to 4, docs run-it 3 to 3, docs trust-it 4 to 4, docs next 3 to 4, compare clarity 2 to 4, compare price 3 to 4, compare trust 4 to 4; critical blockers 8 to 3. secondary (2 personas): docs find-it 3 to 4, docs run-it 3 to 4, docs trust-it 3 to 4, docs next 3 to 4, compare clarity 3 to 3, compare price 3 to 4, compare trust 3 to 3; critical blockers 6 to 3. bystander (1 persona): docs find-it 2 to 4, docs run-it 2 to 3, docs trust-it 3 to 4, docs next 3 to 4, compare clarity 1 to 4, compare price 3 to 4, compare trust 2 to 2; critical blockers 1 to 0. Critical blockers in all: 15 to 6; compare blockers 6 to 0. Source: https://github.com/massrelay-ai/comparegraph/blob/main/docs/reports/2026-10-24-readme-jury.md
